Name: Money Sinks - Community Upgrades
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The much awaited fourth entry to my Money Sinks mod series! This marks the final mod of my originally planned trilogy of Money Sinks, but not the final entry in the series! [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This mod adds several new community upgrades, including:[/size][/color]
5 New Shops!
[list]
[*][b]Caroline's Seasonal Store[/b] - Located in Pierre's general store after purchasing the "Pierre's Seasonal Stock" upgrade. It sells items normally sold during festivals, alongside a tea set! It's open on Mondays, Thursdays, Saturdays, and Sundays from 7:30 to 5:00.[/*]
[*][b]Emily's Cloth Store [/b]- Located in Emily's house after purchasing the "Emily's Clothing Shop" upgrade. It sells various articles of clothing and her sewing machine. She attends to this shop in the morning instead of hanging out in her room.[/*]
[*][b]Leah's Art Gallery[/b] - Located in Leah's house after purchasing the "Leah's Art Gallery" upgrade. It sells various works of art. She attends to this shop in the morning.[/*]
[*][b]Flower Stand & Hot Cocoa Stand[/b] - Stores ran by Evelyn and George during Spring and Winter respectively! These shops are located at the ice cream stand, and are unlocked after purchasing the "Mullner's Ice-Cream Stand" upgrade.[/*]
[/list]Various renovations to Ginger Island, a flower and community garden, renovations to the Hat Mouse's house, and more!

As with all my Money Sinks mods, there is an option for less expensive upgrades!

[size=4][b]All Upgrades & Unlock Requirements[/b][/size]
Below is a list of all the community upgrades, what they do, and when they will appear as purchasable upgrades.
[spoiler][b]Emily's Clothing Shop.[/b] Adds a clothing store to Emily's house. Requires reaching 8 hearts with Emily.
[b]Leah's Art Gallery.[/b] Adds an art gallery to Leah's house. Requires reaching 8 hearts with Leah.
[b]Pierre's Seasonal Stock.[/b] Add an area to Pierre's store that sells items normally reserved for festivals. Requires reaching 8 hearts with Caroline and Pierre.
[b]Connected Mines.[/b] Connect the mine entrance to the quarry tunnel. Requires you to have met the Dwarf.
[b]Town Flower Garden.[/b] Add a small flower garden in town. Only flowers can grow here, but they will never wilt. Requires reaching 7 hearts with Evelyn.
[b]Town Garden.[/b] Add a small plot of farmable land behind Clint's.
[b]Fix the Hat Mouse's House.[/b] Fixes the hat mouse's house.
[b]Mullner's Ice-Cream Stand.[/b] Evelyn will sell flowers and George will sell coffee at the ice-cream stand during Spring and Winter respectively.
[b]Expanded Island Farm Cave.[/b] Enlarge the cave located by your Ginger Island house. Requires you to have unlocked the house at Ginger Island.
[b]Ginger Island Beach Cleanup.[/b] Remove the debris on Ginger Island. Requires you to have unlocked the house at Ginger Island.
[b]Island Expansion.[/b] Make the plot of land above the tiger slime area on Ginger Island accessible. Requires you to have unlocked the house at Ginger Island.
[b]Private Island.[/b] Purchase your very own private island. Requires you to have unlocked the house at Ginger Island. 
[b] Improved Hot Air Balloon.[/b] Marcello will visit the valley every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Interacting with his hot air balloon will allow you take a hot air balloon ride (WIP).
[b]Repair Pirate Ship.[/b] Renovate the crashed pirate ship on Ginger Island into a mini-golf course. Requires you to have unlocked the house at Ginger Island.[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Secret Note Framework is required if you want to get a fun secret Easter egg!

Mods that edit Robin's dialogue menu (such as Self-Serve) will prevent you from accessing the menu to purchase upgrades. There is a config option called "Alternate Upgrade Menu" that, when enabled, will let you access this menu by interacting with the shelf next to Robin's counter. If this still doesn't work, you can access it by using the "MSUpgrades_upgrade_menu" console command.

While this mod is compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded, there are a few minor visual bugs. Furthermore, the Community Garden upgrade is currently disabled when using Stardew Valley Expanded. Both of these are planned to be fixed in a future update.

All upgrades can be disabled via the config menu.

[/list]
